title: Input Types
description: Input types define the kind of information users can enter into a form.
HTML provides various input types such as text, email, password, number, date, and many others.
Each type is designed to collect specific information and improve data accuracy.
Using appropriate input types helps create user-friendly forms and ensures that users provide the correct type of data.

example.code:
<input type="text" placeholder="Enter Name">

<input type="email" placeholder="Enter Email">

<input type="password" placeholder="Enter Password">

<input type="date">
example.output:
Name textbox
Email textbox
Password field
Date picker
